blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution panel is urging the defense team of Vice President Sara Z. Duterte to address nearly ₱818 million in alleged unexplained wealth as the Senate impeachment court prepares to hear defense evidence on Monday, Nov. 9. Speaking at the Saturday News Forum in Quezon City, Bicol Saro Party-list Rep. Terry Ridon highlighted key financial discrepancies uncovered during forensic analysis of records belonging to Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio. The prosecution previously submitted findings by forensic accounting expert Alexander Cabrera, detailing at least ₱817.87 million in alleged undeclared assets and unexplained wealth between 2022 and […]...
